data.name: Mech Skeleton
data.detailed_description:
Mech Skeleton features a unique, high immersion locomotion system.

As a Mech Skeleton Pilot you decide the most effective tactic for each combat situation.

Attack the enemy head on, or be stealth waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike!!

The Mech Skeleton program was born out of desperate times.

In the beginning millions of lives were lost, allied soldiers were simply slaughtered by the seemly unstoppable PNA Death Droids.

It was a stroke of luck, or pure chance while operating in total darkness that we were able to build a weapon capable of pushing the PNA filth back into the dirt.

Using intel gained from a captured PNA scientist, the first Mech Skeleton was activated.
Our soldiers finally had the super human abilities needed to rise up against the enemy.

Initially the program was considered a great success, with the PNA crippled Mech Skeleton pilots were feared on the battlefield.

Until recently, when things changed.

Allied forces have been trying to pass off the recent strange behaviour as a small glitch in the system, nothing to worry about.

However this is no glitch.
The Mech Skeleton program and the technology driving must not be trusted.

Features:
  • Virtual Reality Shooter
  • Unique high immersion locomotion system, swing your arms to move about the world
  • Hide and Seek Stealth
  • Run and Gun Action
  • Primary and Secondary Weapon types
  • Multiple enemy types

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7 - 64 bit
  • Processador: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970/AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or greater
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 11 GB de espaço livre

reviews.review:
[h1] Experienced on the Oculus Rift with Touch Controllers [/h1]

So the whole game took me a little less than 1 hour to complete. I had a lot of fun. I think it's a good deal for the normal price at $3.99USD and one of the better deals on the VR Spring Sale on Steam for $1.59. 

This is fast-paced arcade action shoot 'em up with arm-swing locomotion and the game also has some stealth portions. You have a gun on one hand and a shield on the other. Both gun and shield gun have reloads. So you do have to use your shield strategically when you can't dodge. You have to reload when it's safe to do so or you'll die. Everything dies in one shot, including you and enemies. There's some enemies that you have to place strategic shots though.

I loved the stealth portion. Keep in mind, every part of this game is set pieces. So you traverse the map, but most of the action will go down exactly the same way. So with stealth as long as you memorize the patrols, it shouldn't be too hard to get by the enemies. Still it was fun for me to figure out where the hiding spots were and how to best get by the patrols.

I was able to get finish the game with a 2 sensor setup, but I don't recommend that. I would definitely go full rooomscale. It'll be easier to run and gun that way. The graphics and sounds are not the best, but the gameplay is fast and fluid. This is definitely a purchase I am happy that I made during the Steam VR Spring Sale.

Sale Price Rating 8/10. Normal Price Rating 7/10.
